rationale: Freeze desktop-compatible normalization separately from explicit volume and case comparison.

cases.name: slashes-dots-trim
cases.rationale: Trim, slash replacement, separator collapse, and dot resolution are ordered.

cases.name: primary-root-case-insensitive
cases.rationale: One primary root is removed case-insensitively.

cases.name: above-root
cases.rationale: Above-root traversal is silently discarded in v1.

cases.name: sdcard-not-alias
cases.rationale: The /sdcard alias has no special meaning.

cases.name: uri-not-decoded
cases.rationale: URI syntax and percent escapes are not interpreted.

cases.name: arbitrary-absolute-root
cases.rationale: A remaining leading slash is removed by empty-segment collapse.

comparison.rationale: Case folding is an explicit policy.
